question: According to the Multidimensional Poverty Index 2023, which union territory has the least percentage of poor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• According to the Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2023, **Puducherry** has the least percentage of poor among Union Territories in India.
 
• The Multidimensional Poverty Index measures poverty across multiple dimensions, including health, education, and standard of living.
 
• Puducherry’s achievement is attributed to its strong focus on social welfare schemes and improved access to education and healthcare facilities.
 
• As per the MPI 2023 report, Puducherry exhibits minimal deprivation across indicators like child nutrition, school attendance, and access to basic amenities.
 
• Other Union Territories like Lakshadweep, Delhi, and Chandigarh also perform well but fall behind Puducherry in terms of the lowest poverty rate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)**

 
 
• The MPI is a global measure of poverty developed by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI).
 
• It assesses poverty using three dimensions: health, education, and standard of living, further divided into 10 indicators.
 
• An individual is considered multidimensionally poor if they are deprived in at least one-third of these weighted indicators.
 
 
 
• **Poverty Reduction in India**
 
 
• India has witnessed significant poverty reduction in recent years, driven by welfare programs, economic growth, and improved governance.
 
• Programs like Ayushman Bharat, National Food Security Act, and Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) have contributed to poverty alleviation.
 
 
 
• **Performance of Union Territories**
 
 
• Union Territories like Puducherry, Lakshadweep, and Chandigarh consistently perform well due to focused administration and smaller populations.
 
• Access to universal healthcare, education, and welfare initiatives plays a key role in reducing poverty in these regions.
 
 
 
• **India’s MPI Ranking**
 
 
• India's overall performance in the MPI 2023 reflects its commitment to achieving Sustainable Development Goal 1: No Poverty.
 
• The MPI findings provide critical insights for policymakers to address regional disparities and target areas requiring urgent intervention.
